title: Fullmetal Alchemist
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Brothers Edward and Alphonse Elric try to bring their dead mother back with forbidden alchemy; Edward loses a leg and an arm and Alphonse's soul is bound to a suit of armor. Seeking the Philosopher's Stone to restore their bodies, they uncover a military conspiracy rooted in a past war of extermination (from general knowledge, to verify).
life_message: Holds up taking responsibility for one's mistakes, protecting others, and accepting limits rather than playing god.

content.note: Wikipedia: the Ishbal genocide, a serial killer targeting State Alchemists, many named characters killed in final battles; Common Sense Media (Brotherhood anime, 13+) rates violence 'a lot' with 'violent, gory deaths and injuries' and a murdered girl shown in a pool of blood.

Failed human transmutation leaves a corpse-like creature and costs Ed a leg and Al his body (Wikipedia); Common Sense Media calls horror 'a major element' with 'numerous grotesque characters' and implied cannibalism.
Little sexual content; MangaDex suggestive (to verify).

dominant: Classical virtue ethics, Secular humanism, Transhumanism (critiqued)

delivery.note: Equivalent exchange is spoken outright as the brothers' creed, while vices are literally embodied by homunculi named after sins.

winners_losers: The Elric brothers win by accepting limits and protecting others; those seeking godlike power lose. Sympathy goes to the oppressed Ishvalans and to repentant soldiers (to verify).
